description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier Skilled Nursing Facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment. You will be instrumental in upholding the highest standards of nursing practice and resident well-being.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of exceptional care, regulatory compliance, and staff development. This position is ideal for a visionary leader passionate about fostering a positive and effective clinical team. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with your experience and expertise.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 5 years of nursing experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role.
Proven experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.
